actual_hs_list: 840999 - parts of internal combustion piston engines (liners, cylinder covers, valve spindles/seats, pistons, piston crowns/skirts/rods/rings, fuel injectors, fuel pumps, nozzles, plungers, cams, cam followers, main/crank-pin/crosshead bearings, connecting rods, bushings) - main declared-adjacent line
848330 - bearing housings / plain shaft bearings (main bearing, crank pin bearing, crosshead bearing, bushings) - alternative classification for bearing items sold separately
841330 - fuel injection pumps / fuel feed pumps for engines
841319 / 841370 - pumps (cooling water pump, lub oil pump, hydraulic pumps) - 841370 centrifugal / 841350-841360 positive displacement
841480 - air compressors and their spares (declared 841290 is the parts-of-other-engines residual heading, not compressors)
841430 - compressors used in refrigerating equipment (chilling compressor & spares)
841950 - heat exchangers (heat exchangers, after coolers, oil coolers)
840212 / 840219 - boilers / fresh water generators (FWG) - FWG more correctly 8404 or 8419 depending on type; cannot_verify without catalogue detail
841199 - parts of gas turbines (turbochargers are separately 841480; turbocharger spares cannot_verify)
850132 - DC motors/generators 750W-75kW (declared) - plausible for marine/industrial electric motors and generator sets, but no product page confirms a specific DC machine line

850211 / 850212 / 850213 - generating sets with compression-ignition engines (overhauled complete engines / generator sets for marine auxiliary and power plant) - more accurate than 850132 for gensets
853110 / 853120 / 853180 - gas detection & safety, alarm/indicator panels (ship automation & control systems)
853650 / 853690 / 853929 - marine & industrial electric lights, lamps, switches, electricals
852691 / 852610 - navigation equipment (radio navigational aid apparatus / radar)
848120 / 848190 - valves, governors, hydraulic pump & motor equipment parts
842619 / 842699 - deck crane equipment (ship cranes) - cannot_verify whether cranes are traded whole or only spares
product_summary: Website alhamdmarine.com (Vorani Wadi, Navapara, Bhavnagar, Gujarat; phone +919998694650; email alhamdmarine@gmail.com) describes itself as 'Supplier and Exporter since 2007 for supply of Reusable/Reconditioned/Used Marine Machinery and Spare Parts obtained from the Alang ship breaking yard'. Real catalogue lines listed on the site: Ship Machinery (2-stroke and 4-stroke engine components - liners, anti-polishing rings, cylinder covers, valve housings/spindles/seats, piston crowns/skirts/rods/rings, fuel injectors, fuel pumps, nozzles, plungers, cams, cam followers, main/crank-pin/crosshead bearings, crosshead pins, connecting rods) for MAN-B&W, Sulzer, Mitsubishi, Wartsila-Vasa, MAK, Himsen, Yanmar, Daihatsu, Caterpillar, Niigata, Deutz, Pielstick, SKL, Mirrlees Blackstone, Bergen/Rolls-Royce, Allen, Cummins, Detroit, Crepeille, MWM, Fiat GMT, Hanshin, Stork; overhauled complete engines and generator sets; purifiers; air compressors and spares; chilling compressors and spares; heat exchangers; fresh water generators; oil mist detectors; turbochargers; governors; hydraulic pump and motor equipment; deck crane equipment; marine and industrial electric lights and lamps; ship automation and control systems; marine electricals and electronics; navigation equipment; burners; pumps; gas detection and safety. Note: the 'Engine Parts' sub-page returned HTTP 404, so that line is only evidenced by the navigation menu.
comment: HS comparison: declared 841290 (parts of engines of heading 8425-8429/other engines, residual parts heading) is only partially right - the bulk of the catalogue is marine diesel engine spare parts, which belong to 840999 (parts for compression-ignition piston engines), with bearings separately at 848330 and fuel pumps at 841330. Declared 850132 (DC motors/generators 750W-75kW) is not corroborated by any product page: the site sells overhauled complete engines and generator sets, which would fall under 850211-850213, and marine electricals/lamps under 8536/8539 - so 850132 is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Industry misclassification: the declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is wrong - this is marine equipment trading / ship-recycling-yard spares supply, not mining or metallurgy. Trader signs: the company explicitly describes itself as a 'Supplier and Exporter' of 'Reusable/Reconditioned/Used' machinery 'obtained from' the Alang yard, i.e. it resells second-hand and reconditioned parts rather than manufacturing them; no manufacturing facility, plant or production capability is claimed anywhere on the site. Product lines missing from the declaration: compressors (841480/841430), heat exchangers (841950), purifiers, fresh water generators, turbochargers, hydraulic pumps and motors, deck crane equipment, navigation equipment (8526), gas detection and safety (8531), marine/industrial lighting (8539), burners (8416), ship automation and control systems. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground - the company stays in the base with corrected codes. All product data above is from the company's own website only; no customs line corroborates any of it, so every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No registry, revenue or shipment-volume research was performed in this role. Note: the primary search tool was unavailable during this check (connection refused) and Bing returned only irrelevant results, so the website was reached by direct domain guess; no IndiaMART or third-party catalogue page could be verified, and no PAN/CIN was checked or invented.
